name: Varnam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses
benefit:
1. Under the scheme, a maximum amount of ₹24,000/- will be provided annually to each eligible Transgender student.
   1. For students pursuing PG courses the assistance will be provided for 2 years and for Under Graduate students the assistance will be given for 3 years.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State. 1. The applicant should be Transgender. 1. Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma/ PG courses from Open universities, Distance education, or Private registration are eligible to apply under the scheme.
